name: Kubi ga Nai Ko no Hanashi
source:
Main heroine is a fifth grade student. She collects horror stories with her friend, and then they tell stories to each other and cry together. Today friend brings a new story. “Have you ever heard of a child without a neck?”

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名小學五年級學生。她和朋友收集恐怖故事，然後互相講述，一起哭泣。今天，朋友帶來了一個新故事：「你聽說過沒有脖子的孩子嗎？」

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]］
